scientific_integrity: The hemispherical specialization and general enclosing-ellipsoid contact theory are acknowledged as prior; finite numerical checks are not used in place of an all-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-dimensional statement for a single halfspace-truncated Euclidean ball; not multi-cut or general convex bodies. Priority of all-height formula remains provisional; the a=0 hemisphere case was publicly solved in 2025.
title: Sharp enclosing-ellipsoid transition and monotone excess volume for Euclidean ball caps
